# Optiq

> Code optimizer for SQL, Python, and PySpark. Paste a slow query or script and get a production-ready, idiomatic rewrite plus engine-specific best-practice tips.

Optiq supports 10 SQL engines (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, PL/SQL, SQL Server, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks SQL, ClickHouse), Python (with an in-browser Pyodide runtime), and PySpark. It also includes a Data Builder that generates random data from a user-defined schema as JSON, CSV, or SQL INSERT statements.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Workspace with SQL, Python, PySpark, and Data Builder tabs plus engine-specific tuning tips.
